outputs.location: Data availability section (after 'Quantification and statistical analysis' within the Materials and Methods; immediately before Acknowledgments)
outputs.issues: The DAS is present but not formatted per the journal guidelines. Problems: 1) Entries are not listed as separate bullet points. 2) EMDB entries (EMD-51462, EMD-51466) give accession codes but no resolvable links (identifiers.org or full URLs). 3) The statement 'The source data of this paper are collected in the following database record: https://deposit-2.wwpdb.org' does not specify a repository name/acronym, does not provide an accession number or DOI, and the URL is to a generic site rather than a specific, resolvable record. 4) Data-type descriptions and repository identifiers are inconsistently presented (segmentation maps mentioned but not linked to a repository record).
